changes: Fixed32px source tiles deduplicated/sorted into256slots with checked capacity/extent rejection; source clips intersect before translation to512px atlas cells. The original vertices, projections and painter order are unchanged.

Restore each whole selected tile from A through UNORM sample loads. Source tile ID travels as the immutable first-instance draw argument and a flat integer shader varying; atlas-local pixel derives from position modulo32. No per-frame GPU mapping buffer or mapping upload exists, so no mapping allocation or submission lifetime is omitted. CPU source ID storage remains fixed1KiB plus bounded header.

One T suffix pass and hardware T-to-R resolve, valid-cell R-to-C copies, then complete C-to-target copy. Empty warm frames copy C only. Cold frames reconstruct A/B/C and discard B; unsupported targets retain full fallback. Production full-size warm B restoration and restricted strip-uniform allocation are removed.

Successful completion identity now names A/C allocations. Existing stale/failure/coalescing handling remains the sole validity authority. B remains allocated, charged and included in coherent five-image submission holds.

A final bounded timestamp marker is encoded after each complete graph and before query resolution, including all presentation copies. Existing prefix-copy counter still specifically describes A-to-B logical bytes, not total regional/presentation transfer bytes.

The former restoration primitive and restricted-mask helpers remain test-only for historical component fixtures. They are not production alternate graphs or current regional qualification. Existing GPU fixture expectations still need adaptation before the new approved batch.
